title: Inventory as a Financial Instrument: Evidence from China's Metal Industries
eligible_reason: The firm-level DiD (4_firm_DID.do, Tables 9-10) uses calendar dates common to all treated firms (Treated_Post2013Q2, with additional Treated_Post2012Q2/Treated_Post2012Q4 terms in some columns), pooled OLS with year and fiscal-quarter dummies, a treat main effect, and time-varying firm controls; no firm FE. Other analyses regress inventory on the interest-rate spread (continuous). No staggered adoption.
design_notes: Firm-quarter panel of Chinese listed metal firms. 3_firm.do: reg inv_a irs cogs_a cogssurprisef roa grossmargin fa_a leadtime lnasset i.year i.fiscalperiod [i.provid i.typeid i.iid], vce(cluster ticker). 4_firm_DID.do: reg inv_a Treated_Post2013Q2 Post2013Q2 treat irs [controls] i.year i.fiscalperiod. 2_country.do: country-level time series.
main_or_robustness: robustness (DiD is a supplementary test; not staggered)
data_access: partial (Wind-derived firm fundamentals, SHFE price files and interest-rate series shipped; Wind is licensed)
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text in data/text). Package contents read, no code run.
